items.title: The Judy Garland Show (1963) [Remastered & Complete]
items.description: <div>This is a complete compilation of The Judy Garland Show (1963) as beautifully remastered by Pioneer circa 2000. The collections have long been out of print, with the show in its entirety unavailable for viewing, collecting or purchasing on the Internet through sources official or otherwise. </d
